text:
alex_m: Quick ownership check for Orion on-prem deploy. Neteng still needs the final egress IP list to hand to the customer's firewall team. Who owns the CR and who can add the staging rules? Need to unblock the canary scheduled for tomorrow. cc @julie_neteng @samira

julie_neteng: I can generate the egress IPs but we need the allowed CIDRs from the customer security spreadsheet. Samira, did we get their latest? :thinking:

samira: We have a spreadsheet but it's missing the internal mgmt CIDR. I pinged their security lead this morning, waiting on response. If we don't hear by 17:00 PT we should use the fallback CIDRs in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem-egress

ivan_ops: If we go with the fallback we need a firewall CR approved. I'll create the change request and tag neteng. Drafting now — will call it CR-4942 and attach the IP diff for review.

julie_neteng: On it. Draft IP set looks mostly ok but please remove the `10.0.0.0/16` entry — that's our infra mgmt block and needs separate peering/approval. Suggest the set below for customer egress (fallback):

```
203.0.113.45/32
203.0.113.46/32
198.51.100.0/24  # customer egress pool
```

alex_m: Thanks. Ivan, can you also add a `deploybot` rule so the canary only uses the CIDRs above? And confirm staging DNS will point to the edge-proxy: `staging-orion.redwood.local`

deploybot: reminder: canary windows must be scheduled 02:00-04:00 UTC. I can auto-apply the firewall rules once CR-4942 is approved and merged.

samira: We also need ops-oncall signoff for the rollback plan. @matt_ops are you available to review?

matt_ops: I can review the rollback plan. Also callout: validate airgap fallback (local model cache) before canary. Run `./scripts/egress-check.sh --verify` on staging and confirm artifacts are present.

alex_m: Perf note for runtime: enable prefix caching for this customer to reduce token latency on long contexts. Eng-runtime please ack.

zen_eng: ack — we'll flip `prefix_cache: enabled` for the canary only. PR #3672 created, needs review from @lina.

lina: Reviewing now, minor comment on metrics tagging, will merge once fixed.

ivan_ops: CR-4942 created in Jira: https://jira.redwood/CR-4942. Owners tagged: julie_neteng, matt_ops, lina, zen_eng. Target: merge today EOD PT.

alex_m: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. If customer doesn't respond by 17:00 PT we'll apply the fallback CIDRs and proceed with the canary. I'll post a final go/no-go in this thread after the CR and PRs are green.
